title: Seek Ye First
lyrics_original: Seek ye first the Kingdom of God
Man shall not live by bread alone,
That proceeds from the mouth of God
Ask, and it shall be given unto you.
Knock and it shall be opened unto you

bible_verses.english: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God.’”

He humbled you and allowed you to hunger, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might make you know that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of the Lord’s mouth.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for holding my life securely in Your hands. Forgive me for the moments I let worries crowd out Your presence and place my own plans above Your Kingdom. Teach me to hunger for Your Word each day and to seek Your heart first in all I do. I trust that as I walk with You, You will graciously supply every need. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Life often pulls our focus toward endless worries and daily needs, but Jesus gently invites us to reset our priorities. When we seek His Kingdom and righteousness above all else, we discover the peace of resting in His faithful provision. As you sing this song, let it be a quiet surrender of your anxieties, trusting that God's truth nourishes your soul far more than any earthly comfort.
